about: Corpus of text the engine's YAML reader refuses (or reads as something else) and the lenient line loader in rules_test.go accepts, in the shapes people write into .taad/fitness.yaml. Bounded by who writes it: a prose author (name, because), a pattern author (items of must_not_match and must_not_import), a glob author (files, items of except_files). expect refuse: yamlScalarRefusals must report the first finding on `line` (1-based, in `yaml`). expect accept: it must report nothing. carriers lists every key of fitness.yaml that holds a scalar, and the census test fails when the real file uses a key this list does not name or a carrier has no refuse row and no accept row. The oracle for refuse rows is the YAML 1.2 spec and the engine's own error on SL-010 attempt 1 (ScannerError: mapping values are not allowed here); no YAML parser is installed on the build machine to run them through.
